objective: Make the repository Python test entry point independent of ambient ROS pytest plugins, and keep the Docker project test copy free of local virtual-environment and cache artifacts. The root suite owns no ROS launch tests, so it must run from the declared test paths without discovering incompatible third-party pytest11 entry points from a sourced ROS installation.
acceptance: make test does not auto-load ambient ROS pytest11 plugins.

container-project-check excludes local virtual environments and Python test caches from its temporary source copy, then imports that temporary current-source package instead of the image's preinstalled copy.
The root test entry point continues to execute the declared tests and kernel tests with pytest's built-in functionality.
No production, public-contract, simulator, hardware, or motion-control behavior changes.
evidence: Docker project-check output showing pytest collection proceeds without launch_testing plugin validation failure and imports the artifact-free temporary source copy.
Diff limited to the root test invocation and this task packet.
stop_conditions: A root test requires a ROS launch plugin.
The repair requires a public contract, production code, simulator, hardware, or motion-control change.
The temporary Docker source copy cannot run project validation without local virtual environments or caches.
